items.title: Tony Robbins: 4 rules the world's greatest investors follow
items.summary: Author, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Tony Robbins sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down the four things every elite investor does in common, and why you should run your money like a side business.

items.title: Rivian CEO talks robotaxis: 'I don't think it's the end of car ownership'
items.summary: As Rivian (RIVN) continues to build its own R2 robotaxi with Uber (UBER), Rivian founder and CEO RJ Scaringe joins Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to share his thoughts on the future of robotaxis, car ownership, and more.

items.title: Tony Robbins: How to make yourself irreplaceable in the AI era
items.summary: Author, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Tony Robbins explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi why people are being replaced by those who know how to use AI rather than by AI itself, and why the best coders are now running 50 AI agents at once.
